name: social-intel
description: Fixed two-call, read-only web corroboration bundle for one explicit topic or brand query. It returns independent Exa semantic-search and Tavily advanced-search results for agent-side synthesis; it does not query Reddit, X/Twitter, or other social-platform APIs. Each step is paid independently through the SELAT Router over MPP or x402.

topic.description: Explicit natural-language web-search topic or query used unchanged in both searches. Add dates or recency terms when freshness matters.
